name: Washington caselaw — Caselaw Access Project
scopeNote: Preserves CAP's Washington jurisdiction assignment: 41,045 Supreme Court records, 65,131 Court of Appeals records under four source court labels, and one historical Washington District Court record. Includes territorial-era records and upstream dates from 1854 through 2019. Coverage reflects the pinned historical archive, not every decision issued by those courts.
